speaker: A
line: Who a company hires, and who walks out, says a lot about where it's heading. DOMINO reads those moves and turns them into decisions: who to hire, and what to sell, and to whom.
focus: DOMINO home for Abacus.AI: Hire and Find buyers in the left nav

speaker: B
line: Hiring first. DOMINO watches who joins and who leaves, and spots the roles a company will need before the job is posted. Here, it's an ML platform role at Abacus.AI. Then it brings in opted-in candidates who fit, field by field.
focus: Predicted opening card, then People you can hire

speaker: A
line: A candidate opted in and asked for an intro. Every line in the draft has a footnote that opens its source. I approve it. We set delivery to crash right after our test inbox accepts. Resume. It's delivered once, and the retry is skipped.
focus: Footnote, Approve, crash message, Resume from checkpoint, Already delivered

speaker: B
line: Selling works the same way. EWOR is hiring to build AI infrastructure, so it will likely need compute and inference. DOMINO projects that need for a seller of GPU inference, and finds the person at EWOR who decides.
focus: EWOR row: direct signal, decider shown as role and initial

speaker: A
line: Then it drafts the message, built only from verified facts, each footnoted to its source. Nothing goes out until a person approves it, and then it's sent exactly once.
focus: EWOR draft with its footnoted facts, awaiting approval

speaker: B
line: Why trust it? Every claim links to its dated source. When a team moves because of an acqui-hire, DOMINO spots it and doesn't call it an opening. And it checks the budget before any paid call.
focus: Held: acqui-hire card with its dated source

speaker: A
line: Each run saves a checkpoint after every step, so a stopped run picks up where it left off without paying twice. Rules make the decisions. The model only reads profiles and writes drafts.
focus: Ledger: a row per call, budget caps at the top

speaker: B
line: So DOMINO tells a company who it should hire next, and who it should sell to, with a source behind every claim.
